content:
maya: heads-up: Acme wants tenant embeddings cache + SSO. timeline tight, need MVP vs v1 decision by EOD Fri.

devin: quick take: deliver read-only cache (per-tenant namespace, 24h TTL) + fallback in ~2 sprints if we skip write API and prewarm.

arjun: infra risk: multi-tenant cache increases memory pressure on dedicated pools; writes add oom risk. recommend deferring writes to v1.

sam: if we defer writes we must add telemetry to measure cold-starts, per-tenant hit/miss and latency. include acceptance criteria.

liz: proposed MVP acceptance checklist: 1) read-only cache with per-tenant namespace and 24h TTL; 2) telemetry: hit/miss + p95 per tenant; 3) fallback to origin model on miss; 4) runbook + rollback.

maya: gate MVP on Acme signoff and performance SLO: p95 < 200ms for cached requests.

devin: impl notes: cache service (rust) behind router; fast KV lookup; optional background prewarm disabled for MVP (saves ~2 weeks). feature flag + canary plan.

arjun: ops asks: add eviction metrics, memory alarms, and temp per-tenant quotas during canary. circuit-breaker on miss amplification.

sam: canary plan: 5 customers (incl Acme) -> gate on hit-rate > 25% and no P95 regressions before broader rollout.

liz: rollout cadence: canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with immediate fallback toggle. update customer comms.

maya: decision: ship read-only cache in MVP, defer write API + prewarm + compaction to v1. update timeline and launch criteria.

devin: timeline impact: deferring writes reduces backend work by ~3 sprints, aligns with target launch. will include cost estimate in PR.

arjun: note added: cached vectors increase GPU memory usage; include cost delta in docs.

sam: eval plan: run prompt set cached vs uncached to ensure quality parity and verify fallback determinism.

maya: action items: devin - PR + cost estimate by Tue; arjun - eviction + memory alarms by Wed; sam - eval prompt set + dashboard by Wed; liz - launch criteria doc + comms draft by Thu.

deploy-bot: PR opened -> github.com/redwood/cache/mvp-readonly (devin) :rocket:

devin: PR has toggleable flag and canary rollout plan, tagging @maya @liz.

maya: decision rule: if canary shows >25% hit and no perf regression we call MVP done; else disable flag and follow contingency plan.

liz: release items: support runbook, FAQ for intermittent misses, customer opt-in notes.

arjun: final ops note: enable temp per-tenant quota and circuit-breaker thresholds for canary.

sam: consensus. scheduling short sync Fri to finalize acceptance criteria.

maya: thanks all, i'll consolidate decision doc after Fri's sync. :thumbsup:
